title: The Name Bestowed Before Birth
intro: Picture a quiet sanctuary filled with earnest supplication after long years of waiting. From the unseen comes an answer carrying a name never given before, promising wisdom from early years and a life marked by devotion, compassion, and purity.
clues: I was named by Allah Himself before I was born, with a name never given to anyone before me.
I was granted as an answer to earnest supplication by elderly parents who thought offspring was beyond possibility.
I was given wisdom, judgment, and the Scripture while I was still young.
I was dutiful to my parents and compassionate to others, and I was not arrogant or disobedient.
Allah decreed peace upon me on the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive.
My father Zakariyya received the glad tidings of me from the angels while standing in prayer in the sanctuary (mihrab).

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Shu'ayb (Jethro)
Prophet Idris (Enoch)
Prophet Ishaq (Isaac)
Prophet Yusuf (Joseph)
Prophet Yahya (John)

trial.label: Blessing and Trial
options: Swallowed by a great fish for leaving in anger
Thrown into a blazing fire for smashing idols
Denied shelter and left to be raised by a she-wolf
Granted to elderly parents after earnest supplication
Confronted Pharaoh and led an exodus across the sea
trial.answer: Granted to elderly parents after earnest supplication

location.label: Key Place
options: The sanctuary (mihrab) where glad tidings were announced
The blazing fire prepared by idolaters
The belly of the great fish in the deep sea
The cave where sleepers rested for centuries
The valley of the ants on a royal march
location.answer: The sanctuary (mihrab) where glad tidings were announced

outcome.label: Divine Honor
options: Pelted from the sky by stones of baked clay
Swallowed alive by the earth for arrogance over treasure
Destroyed by a thunderous blast for hamstringing the she-camel
Drowned with an arrogant host in the parted sea
Peace upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I am raised alive
outcome.answer: Peace upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I am raised alive

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
